name: @bloopai/debugger-mcp

tools.name: start_debug_session
tools.description: Starts a new debug session for a target program, returning session ID and initial state.

targetType.description: Type of target to debug (e.g., 'node', 'python'). This will be validated against available adapters at runtime. Defaults to 'python'.

targetPath.description: Absolute path to the executable file or main script of the program to be debugged. Relative paths are not supported and will likely cause errors. Ensure `cwd` (current working directory) is also set correctly if your debug adapter or program relies on it, though the path itself must be absolute.

stopOnEntry.description: Whether to stop at the entry point of the program.

launchArgs.description: Arguments to pass to the program being debugged.

cwd.description: Working directory for the debug session. This is the directory from which the debugged program will be launched. This setting is important if the program itself uses relative paths to access files or resources, or if the debug adapter requires a specific CWD for its operation. Note: `targetPath` should still be an absolute path.

env.description: Environment variables for the debug session.

inputSchema.description: Starts a new debug session for a given target program. Supports standard DAP launch arguments and allows passing additional, adapter-specific parameters directly. Returns the session ID and initial state.

tools.name: set_breakpoint
tools.description: Sets a breakpoint in a file at a given line.

sessionId.description: The ID of the debug session.

filePath.description: The path to the file in which to set the breakpoint.

lineNumber.description: The line number for the breakpoint (1-based).

tools.name: evaluate_expression
tools.description: Evaluates an expression in the context of a debug session.

sessionId.description: The ID of the debug session.

frameId.description: Optional frame ID in which to evaluate the expression.

context.description: Context in which to evaluate the expression (e.g., 'watch', 'repl', 'hover'). Defaults to 'repl'.

tools.name: get_variables
tools.description: Retrieves child variables for a given scope or structured variable reference.

sessionId.description: The ID of the debug session.

variablesReference.description: The reference ID (number) for a variable scope (e.g., from a stack frame) or a structured variable (e.g., an object or array) whose children/properties are to be retrieved. Typically obtained from a stack frame, a previous `evaluateExpression` call, or a `getVariables` call for a complex variable.

tools.name: get_call_stack
tools.description: Retrieves the current call stack for a thread in a debug session.

sessionId.description: The ID of the debug session.

threadId.description: The ID of the thread for which to retrieve the call stack.

tools.name: continue
tools.description: Continues execution of the debug target and returns the current state of the debug session.

sessionId.description: The ID of the debug session.

threadId.description: Optional ID of the thread to continue. If not provided, all threads may be continued.

inputSchema.description: Continues execution of the debug target and returns the current state of the debug session.

sessionId.description: The ID of the debug session.

threadId.description: The ID of the thread to step over.

tools.name: step_in
tools.description: Steps into the function call at the current execution line.

sessionId.description: The ID of the debug session.

threadId.description: The ID of the thread to step into.

inputSchema.description: Steps into the function call at the current execution line.

tools.name: step_out
tools.description: Steps out of the current function.

sessionId.description: The ID of the debug session.

threadId.description: The ID of the thread to step out of.

inputSchema.description: Steps out of the current function.

tools.name: terminate_session
tools.description: Terminates a debug session and the debuggee process.

sessionId.description: The ID of the debug session to terminate.

inputSchema.description: Terminates a debug session and the debuggee process.

tools.name: list_adapters
tools.description: Lists all registered debug adapter configurations.

tools.name: get_pending_async_events
tools.description: Retrieves any pending asynchronous debug events queued on the server.

tools.name: get_session_details
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific debug session, including its state (e.g., running, paused, terminated), active threads, and the call stack if the session is paused. Useful for understanding the current execution context, inspecting variables, or deciding the next debugging step.

sessionId.description: The ID of the debug session to get details for.

inputSchema.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific debug session, including its state (e.g., running, paused, terminated), active threads, and the call stack if the session is paused. Useful for understanding the current execution context, inspecting variables, or deciding the next debugging step.
